name: ONCE — One Million Scenes for Autonomous Driving
description: Large-scale autonomous driving dataset developed by Huawei Noah's Ark Lab and Sun Yat-sen University to benchmark semi-supervised and self-supervised 3D perception methods. Consists of 1 million LiDAR scenes and 7 million camera images collected over 144 driving hours across diverse geographical locations, weather conditions, and times of day. Provides 15,000 fully annotated 3D frames spanning 5 core object classes alongside 985,000 unannotated frames.
